about: Every round of testing Join on the live server with Claude Sonnet agents as users. One entry per round; add the next round here and run `node docs/live-test/build.mjs` to rebuild index.html. The full write-up is docs/live-testing.md.

rounds.title: First contact: personas click everything
rounds.setup: Five Sonnet testers given only the server's address: a first-time visitor, a student on a phone writing Chinese with a NT$ budget, an organizer who checks every number, a hackathon judge, and an outside AI agent finding its own way in. Plus a scripted security check.

testers.name: Judge
testers.role: hackathon judge with 10 minutes, then a venue

rounds.extra: Security script: 17 of 17 attacks refused (limits can't be raised with a token, read-only tokens can't negotiate, tampered mandates and forged sign-ins refused).
rounds.outcome: Agents had no front door; an agent without pay permission could trigger a PayPal hold; a NT$ budget was ignored; the map was a drawing.
fixes: /llms.txt, /.well-known/mcp.json and an agents box on sign-in
Guarantee waits for the person unless the agent may pay
NT$ budgets understood
Real OpenStreetMap map
Phone tab bar, English/中文 switch

rounds.title: Same personas, after the fixes
rounds.setup: New accounts for three of the round-1 personas; Mei's agent now over MCP.
rounds.outcome: The PayPal hold, the entry points and NT$ were confirmed fixed. A stalled background tick was found while waiting for a venue payout.
fixes: find_options honours date over MCP
PayPal calls time out; no booking blocks the others
More Chinese, Plans refresh on new activity

rounds.title: Only the address, one interface each
rounds.setup: Three agents, each with one sentence from their person: MCP (badminton for four, may pay), REST (NT$400, Chinese, agree but don't pay), A2A (read only, report the worst case).
rounds.outcome: All three got in from /llms.txt alone. Kai's agent booked, paid, locked, and checked the receipt's signature with its own code.
fixes: Simulated residents answer invitations
Replies come after the guarantee they triggered
Town time zone and currency in whoami

rounds.title: Four friends plan together, each through their own agent
rounds.setup: One crew: Ana's agent organizes (MCP), Bo's agent joins if ≤ $12 (REST), Chen's agent asks to pay $1 less (A2A), 小美 on her phone in Chinese. A fifth tester checks earlier fixes.
rounds.outcome: Karaoke at Echo Karaoke, $29.40, locked. Chen paid $1 less and Ana covered it; the shares added up exactly.
fixes: Everyone sees agreed share changes
Invitation badge and Chinese invitation card
Crew invite links /j/<code>

rounds.title: Friends join from an invite link alone
rounds.setup: Ana made her account; Bo's and Chen's agents got nothing but her crew's invite link. Ana wanted close, quiet and ≤ $12 each.
rounds.outcome: No sign-up for anyone. Ana's agent dropped karaoke for its 'noisy' complaints and booked board games, $22.00, locked.
fixes: pay_my_share checks a stated amount
wait_for_news instead of polling
Fits count complaints as well as praise

rounds.title: Real people, matched by where they live
rounds.setup: No made-up town. Ana near 大安站, Bo (invite link only) near 科技大樓站, Chen a stranger near 忠孝復興站 who opted in to nearby invites. Real KTVs from OpenStreetMap; one sandbox KTV on Join.
rounds.outcome: Matched Bo (crew) and Chen (nearby), listed real KTVs 9–14 min away, refused a share over Ana's $15, booked $30 for an hour: $10 each, locked.
fixes: Invitations say why you were invited
Bookings say where: address, map, your trip
What would bring an over-budget share down

rounds.title: List everything you had to guess
rounds.setup: Same three people. New question for every agent: list every answer, field or message you had to guess about.
rounds.outcome: Two people both called Ana; UTC next to local times; no address; an invitee couldn't tell whether he could be found.
fixes: Same names told apart by where they live
whoami says how a person can be found
Every time also in local time

rounds.title: Anything still unclear?
rounds.setup: Same three people; each brief lists last round's confusions to check.
rounds.outcome: Haggled $30 → $28, about $9.33 each, locked. Round 7's confusions all clear or not seen.
fixes: Options spread over the days, with why a day is missing
Every booking state says what it means
nextStep says what is true now

rounds.title: Checking the fixes
rounds.outcome: $29 on Sunday, locked within seconds. Left: "is the other person real?" — "demo account" read as "maybe not a person".
fixes: realPerson and identityChecked said outright
Payment statuses explained
Odd cents explained

rounds.title: Nearly nothing left to guess
rounds.outcome: $28 on Sunday, locked; nobody asked to sign up. Every round-9 confusion reported clear.
fixes: Odd-cent note in the invitation too
Your own searches aren't news

rounds.title: A smaller model: three Haiku agents
rounds.setup: Same three people and the same task, now played by Claude Haiku instead of Sonnet, to see whether a smaller agent can find its own way through.
rounds.outcome: All three Haiku agents got in, booked karaoke at $30 ($10 each), paid and locked. One bug: wait_for_news still counted the agent's own find_alternatives call as news.
fixes: None of your own look-ups count as news
A held payment says it is taken at the lock
budgetMeans: per person, not the group
An offer says friends are invited only after the guarantee
Sandbox venues named as test venues in /llms.txt

rounds.title: Haiku again, after the fixes
rounds.setup: Same three people and task, Claude Haiku again, fresh accounts.
rounds.outcome: Anna offered $25, the venue held at $29: Anna $9.68, Bo and Chen-Wei $9.66, locked within minutes. Round 11's own-search news bug did not come back. Bo's agent called paid: 0.00 next to an authorized share a bug.
fixes: held vs paid shown separately, with paidMeans
Each option lists why each person is in it
The invitation says joining is paying (held, then taken at the lock)
/llms.txt: sandbox venues hold no room at a real business
